summary_en: Palladium is a chemical element with symbol Pd and atomic number 46. It is a rare and lustrous silvery-white metal discovered in 1803 by William Hyde Wollaston. He named it after the asteroid Pallas, which was itself named after the epithet of the Greek goddess Athena, acquired by her when she slew Pallas.
summary_ko: Palladium은(는) 전이 금속 원소로, 교육·연구·산업에 활용되는 기본 소재다. 상온에서는 이며 안전 지침을 따라 다루는 것이 권장된다.
